posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: I apologize if your message on the website went un-responded-to. We have spoken with the shipper, and their current estimate for delivery is "7-10 days" from now. Their previous estimates have been off by quite a bit, but this is the shortest "time to delivery" estimate they've given us so far, so we can only hope that it is correct. In any case, as soon as we get the delivery, we will ship out all of our backorders ASAP, even if it means working on holidays and weekends. You will receive a FedEx tracking number for your online order as soon as it ships.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
We have evidently been having some trouble with emails lately. Here is an update for all of you on the forum who are wondering about your order. The games are currently in a cargo container on their way to the US from China, but the shipping company currently tells us that they are about a week out. That means that they are unlikely to arrive in time for Christmas. However, they should arrive some time a week later. As soon as they do, we will work overtime to ship out all of the games (I'm even planning to spend a chunk of Christmas packing games if they are here by then). You will receive a FedEx tracking number when they do ship.

 

Thanks for your patience everyone, and sorry about the delay.

posts.cooked: We got a ridiculously huge cargo container full of games yesterday and spent all day unloading it. We are now beginning the packing and shipping process. Boxes will ship out in the order they were received, and you will get your tracking number as soon as we create the label (so if you ordered something that was out of stock in late October, for example, you should have your tracking number already). Everything ordered from our store should ship out by the end of the week, and brick-and-mortar stores should start having stock again in a couple of weeks.
